title: 诠释的权衡：历史研究中的置信度、权衡与理论流变——从人物还原到范式转移的五个应用 / The Tradeoffs of Interpretation: Confidence, Trade-offs, and Theoretical Change in Historical Research — Five Applications from Restoring Persons to Paradigm Shifts
description:
中文. 本著作提出“诠释即置信度分配”的诊断框架，用以解释历史学为什么在材料增加时仍然争吵不休。

核心主张：诠释就是给一组互相竞争的命题分配置信度；“他确实说过”置信度高，“他因此被排挤”置信度中，“这标志时代转向”置信度低。一个诠释的形状，由这组分布决定。

结构与证据：25 章、附录 A—AC、19 幅图；四层置信度（观察、推理、诠释、因果）配可反驳条件；以贝叶斯更新示范先验敏感性，以编码敏感性模拟说明“合理编码也能翻掉弱结论”。

诚实的纪律：每条判断标层级与强度；把一次失败（C-A-T 在史学中的形式化尝试被撤回）写进正文而非只放附录；开放问题、可证伪登记簿与自诊工作表随书公开。

边界：在历史这类对象上，诊断只能到隐喻一级；置信度分配可操作，三角位置尚不可独立测量。

版本：2026-10-18，206 页，25 章，19 图，附录 A—AC；含工作手册与复算脚本，内容 CC BY 4.0，代码 MIT。

本版更新（2026-10-18 地基版）。本版把全书的共同前提写到卷首：现实中不存在无限——无限只作为极限出现在模型里，从不出现在现实系统的实际状态里。有限性本身只说明“有上界”；它要变成“必须让出一样”，还需要三个条件同时成立：需求随规模增长、描述/组合/传递共享同一承载者、同时维持两种活动更贵（交互惩罚 ψ>0）。因此“至多取二”一律是“紧预算（K/D 有界）下至多取二”的简写；若预算增长快于需求，三项可以同时满格。

本版新增内容。第 6 章新增“有限性诊断”：证据、史家时间与读者注意力三重有限；置信度分配是有限性的结果，C-A-T 只是借用而非前提。卷首总纲明确：证据、时间与注意力都是有限的。

系列 / Series. 同一作者的独立研究系列：六本学术专著 + 两本通俗读本。入口与外部登记库：https://github.com/lyp0746/knowledge-tradeoffs；源码与可复算脚本：https://github.com/lyp0746/interpretation-tradeoff。首选预览文件：interpretation-tradeoff-print.pdf（印刷版）。

English. Abstract (English). This work presents a diagnostic framework: interpretation is the allocation of confidence to competing propositions. Core thesis: “he did say it” carries high confidence, “he was therefore marginalised” medium, “this marks a turning point of an age” low; the shape of an interpretation is the distribution of those confidences. Structure and evidence: 25 chapters, appendices A–AC, 19 figures; four confidence layers (observation, inference, interpretation, causation), each with refutation conditions; a Bayesian demonstration of prior sensitivity and a coding-sensitivity simulation showing that reasonable coding can invert weak conclusions. Discipline: every judgement carries its layer and strength; one failure — the attempt to formalise C-A-T positions in historiography — is reported in the main text, not buried in an appendix; worksheets and a falsifiability register are included. Boundaries: for objects like history, diagnosis reaches only the level of metaphor; confidence allocation is operational, while triangle positions are not yet independently measurable. Edition: 2026-10-18, 206 pages, 25 chapters, 19 figures, appendices A–AC.

What is new in this edition (2026-10-18, Finitude Edition). The common premise is now stated at the front: there is no infinity in reality — infinity appears only as a limit in models, never as a property of a real system. Finitude alone only says that there is a ceiling; to yield a trade-off it also needs three conditions: demand grows with scale, description/composition/transfer share one bearer, and maintaining two activities at once is more expensive (interaction penalty ψ>0). “At most two” is therefore shorthand for “at most two under a tight budget (bounded K/D)”; if the budget grows faster than demand, all three can be full.

New in this edition. Chapter 6 adds a finitude diagnosis: evidence, the historian’s time and reader attention are all finite; confidence allocation is a consequence of finitude, and C-A-T is borrowed rather than presupposed. The front matter states that evidence, time and attention are finite.
notes: 科目（中文）：史学理论 Historiography、历史哲学 Philosophy of History、诠释学 Hermeneutics、科学哲学 Philosophy of Science、知识论 Epistemology、复杂系统 Complex Systems。语言：中文（含英文摘要）。结构：25 章，约 201 页。首选预览文件：interpretation-tradeoff-print.pdf（印刷版）。引用格式见 CITATION.cff。
